translation.text: And in those days the prayer of the holy ones[a] will reach the Lord, and the days of your judgment[b] will come upon you.

footnotes.text: Or “saints.” The selected text has “holy ones”; Charles 1906 apparatus on printed page 202 records “righteous” in other witnesses.

The Charles 1906 selected text clearly prints ኵነ*ክሙ with an internal critical star; the shorter form’s meaning is not independently established here. The separate full noun ኵነኔ is supported by Dillmann’s 1865 lexicon, column 856. This is a different edited edition, not a newly inspected manuscript or proof of Charles’s unprinted letters.
